reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Happen you know, my beloved ones, that when these vessels were discharged, they were discharged in [great] slaughter, but those [three garments drew out] these vessels from them.

They are like the form of a man who has fallen into a purulent sickness. Other wounds and diseases are in his body, and even bile and other poisons are in his inner limbs. He achieves good health by a wise doctor, who gives him one remedy to drink that causes his purulent sickness to break out above, and gives him another medicine to drink that causes his sickness to discharge below, and he gives him yet another medicine to drink that cures his wounds for him [from within,] calmly and silently.

Through the skill of a wise doctor, with his effective medicines to consume that take away all sicknesses in this manner and dissolve all magic, the doctors shall [bring healing, for] they work cures through the aroma of the medicine, other wounds [, that is] what is hidden, they at last tear them out from [within. They are] manifested above and below [and healed through] the aroma of edible medicines that were placed upon them.

This is also what these vessels of water, of darkness and of fire are like, which are hidden in the body of all the rulers above; while the Living Spirit is like the wise doctor. These three healing drugs are the three garments that the Living Spirit assumes upon his body: of wind, of water, and of fire. Through them he has set in order the things below. For by those three garments he has been displayed to the rulers who are above, with hard-heartedness, with shaking and fear, with derangement; from them he discharged the three vessels, those of water, of darkness and of fire.

The case of these vessels is just like a child who is in his mother's womb and is swathed by seven garments. The first is the marrow, the second is the bones, the third is the tendons, the fourth is the flesh, the fifth the veins, the sixth the blood, the seventh the skin of the body that covers him. The other garment also [swathes him in the womb of his mother. His mother also is just like] this child. The marrow and the bones, the sinews and flesh, the veins and blood and skin, together with the garment that she wears and the linen that swathes her, total nine. Together with the nine of the child, these and the others, they shall complete and make eighteen garments. Now, you shall find the soul of this child is entwined within all these.

And look see: When the smell of the action of the demon, which brings about the stench of birth, will reveal the child; immediately [the child] shall [push through] all [these things] and it emerges from a crack that has become visible, while no tear nor wound occurs in the body of the child. In the same way as this child opens up the womb of his mother, so is it also with these vessels of water, of darkness and of fire. The actions that open up his mother to the child, and she shakes him out and reveals him; these are the three living garments that the Living Spirit assumed on his body.
For by the aspect of the garment of water [he discharged the waters] from the rulers; he moved [them forth, for] they are the poison and death with which their veins and entrails are filled.

By the aspect of the garment of wind, in which he was revealed [to the rulers,] he has swept away and erased the entire destructive shadow and dirt, discharged it down to the earth. Afterwards he swept it out and confined it in the vessel of darkness that surrounds the universe.

Also, by the garment of living fire, through its splendour and vigour, he discharged the fire of the darkness from all the rulers and threw it down upon this earth. He swept it another time from the earth and confined it in the vessel that surrounds all the worlds, and they call it the wall of great fire.

Now, those three garments, through which he established these three things, he did not peel them off all at once; but he stripped them off one by one at the appropriate time [, and cast each one] down to the earth [in its season.]
In this way the universe of the [worlds was set in order through] his vessels [, and] these vessels like [walls encompass all the worlds.]

The use of the matter, and the management of these vessels that were swept out and discharged from above to earth, have brought an advantage and benefit of twelve great deeds. Afterwards, they were swept from the earth and pushed outside to the edges of the worlds and to the {extremity}.
The first deed is this: So that evil-doing does not increase in the universe, neither in the creations nor in the trees [; for it has set i]tself up in three things.
The [first is lust, which is in the creations and in all flesh.]

The second is error [and deception.] Indeed, about this I have spoken to you as I [have already said.] For, if it were so, if [the vessel of water] had not been swept down from above, but rather the waters existing up till now in the rulers above [had remained in them, the] torrents that would flow [down from them] and the droplets that would [drip] down, so lust would have sprouted [and increased i]n the trees and in the fruits as well as all flesh [upon the earth] down [here t]oday [; and] you could not find a single person [who lives] in the [world as] a saint does [, nor one who] is master of [his desire.]

Not only this, but if the vessel of darkness had not been swept out and thrown down to the earth, nor swept from the earth and cast outside the region of the worlds into this pit; again the drops of darkness, which will drip down from it, and the torrents that will continue to flow down from above to the earth and assume the trees and all flesh, would have multiplied, and the forgetfulness that is in a thousand people today you would have found in just one person. There is not one among mankind [who could find within] him [even] the thought and the knowledge of the [truth.]

Furthermore, if the fire were in the rulers of the worlds of the heavens until today, and had not been swept out and cast down to the earth, and swept from the earth and shut up inside the vessel of fire that surrounds the worlds; [then] this fire [would have poured down from] above through the torrent [, and the torrent would have flowed further] below;
and the dark fire would have multiplied in the tree and in fruit and in all flesh. The power of the fire that is now in a thousand people, you would have found it occurring in a single person today.
Behold, I have taught you about this single evil that was purified by three archetypes [of the living garments.]
The second deed: Al[l] the heavens [are cleansed] of the sediment and the pollution [that was in them,] so that [purity] surpasses in them [over all uncleanness.]

[The third]: The heavens and the firmaments [are freed of their b]urden [and are] relieved from the weight-carriers [that bore them,] and it ceased being heavy. This rich one [is set free and exalted] above.
The fourth: That they might purify and cleanse their dwelling places [from everything foreign to the light.]
The fifth: Because the greatness and the richness that dwells in these ships, as it [abides within them,] you might find them living in these ships, purified and holy.
The sixth: That you might find the mixed, incomplete, and unconfined temples above at rest and purified; since rest will reach them and pass through them and purify them.
The seventh: [That the proper] nature alone of the vessels, which will advance and extend to their places and sites [, might be set] in [due order.]
The eighth: That great enclosures and walls would be made, and confine everything.
The tenth deed: That they would become releasers and purifiers of everything at the end of the universe like the fire [that] burns [and consumes all that remains of darkness and evil.]
The eleventh deed: [That they] will make a crossing [way to the outside,] and the entire ruling-power [of darkness shall pass through it]

to the outer land, for they were not envious of this [, unlike] a man who is richer than them; because the aeons of light are outside [all of this, dwelling in] the place [of rest and] of peace, the place of honour and grace, the place where the joy of the householders who dwell in it shall never pass away nor recede.

The twelfth: That you might find all the deeds of loss hidden from the aeons of light, because of the wall of fire that surrounds the entire building; and these unclean things are displayed (only) in its [outermost boundary, and they shall never penetrate inward.]

There was a need for these twelve great deeds because the vessels that were discharged and swept out from the firmaments to the earth, and were also swept from the earth to the {extr[emity of the worlds; and] the three words of life watch over them that [ar]e set over them in great power [and authority,] that they might watch over them at the last time; because of this, they are firmly set thus in these fetters, in the way that I have told you.
